Name: Shane Sprite Edit
Author: SaintNyx
Description:
A simple edit of Shane's sprite. The edits are based off of DC Burgers Portraits but is not necessary to enjoy. This mod edits all his sprites including his beach outfit and jojo uniform, I did my best to keep it looking vanilla to keep in line with the rest of the games sprites.
